response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT p.fundflux, s.aream2, s.volm3, s.boxx, s.boxy FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref), g AS (SELECT fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN boxx IS NOT NULL AND boxy IS NOT NULL AND boxx <> 0 THEN (boxy - boxx) * 1.0 / boxx END) AS avg_rel_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN aream2 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN aream2 IS NOT NULL AND volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN volm3 END), 0) AS ratio FROM j GROUP BY fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.fundflux, g.avg_rel_diff, g.ratio, g.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS excess_over_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.ratio > a.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A funding source's area-to-volume ratio is its total aream2 divided by its total volm3, using only records where both values are present. The request defines per-record calculation only for the Y-vs-X difference, so the ratio is treated as an aggregate.
The relative difference is averaged only over records with non-null boxx and boxy and nonzero boxx, to avoid dividing by zero.

The simple average is the unweighted mean of the per-funding-source ratios. Projects with a NULL fundflux are kept as their own group, which is included in that mean but cannot be told apart from a funding source named by the data.
The inner join drops spatial records whose arcref has no matching project, as requested.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is the average of the per-record aream2/volm3 values within each funding source, skipping records where either value is missing or volm3 is 0.
